title: Text-bearing Excel MSForms rectangle-label oracle fixture

cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned manifest consumed through public Excel/VBIDE automation.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, or binary inspection.

prerequisites: Windows desktop session with Microsoft Excel installed.
Excel macro execution allowed for the generated workbook when opening the fixture.
Trust access to the VBA project object model enabled when generating through automation.
The Microsoft Forms 2.0 UserForm designer available through Excel/VBA.
A stable desktop scaling/theme should be recorded by the capture bead; this fixture does not claim pixel parity.

notes.units: MSForms automation geometry values are in points. The capture bead records resulting pixels under the active DPI and theme.
notes.font: The label uses explicit regular Tahoma 8.25 point text so the first text oracle is simple, normal-size, and reproducible enough to inspect. If the host substitutes the font, the capture evidence must record that limitation.
notes.text: The caption is intentionally short and unwrapped so the first observation focuses on baseline placement, anti-aliasing, and glyph pixel colors rather than layout complexity.
notes.colors: The label keeps the W003 blue fill and adds white foreground text so glyph pixels are visually and programmatically easy to distinguish from the fill.
notes.generatedArtifacts: Generated .xlsm files are evidence artifacts, not source inputs. Keep them under docs/evidence/W004_text_label_oracle_pixels/ with hashes if committed.
